name: QuillBot
tagline: AI paraphrasing, grammar, summarization, and writing tools

notes: Great yes candidate: wrapper-heavy, high willingness to cancel.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for QuillBot (AI paraphrasing, grammar, summarization, and writing tools). Requirements:

- Core loop: Create text boxes for paraphrase/summarize/grammar, call an LLM and LanguageTool, and save/export outputs.
- Needs: LLM API.
- Needs: LanguageTool or grammar API.
- Needs: browser extension if in-app writing is needed.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: browser/Word extensions; plagiarism/AI detector workflows; rewrite modes.
